summary.text: Brian Mulder is a Republican state representative who has represented South Dakota House District 11 since 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

A managing director at Volunteers of America, he chairs the House Health and Human Services Committee and faces Democrat Sonja Mentzer and Libertarian Tracey Quint, along with fellow Republican incumbent Keri Weems, for the district's two seats, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Brian Mulder was born in Granite Falls, Minnesota, and earned a bachelor's degree from Crown College in 2003, according to Ballotpedia.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he said he grew up on a farm in central Minnesota, had worked as an executive pastor at a Sioux Falls church and as a civilian alongside U.S. military chaplains in Germany, and was serving as a managing director at Volunteers of America-Dakotas.
Mulder took office on January 10, 2023, and for 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the House Health and Human Services Committee and a member of the House Transportation Committee.

In the 2022 survey, he said he favored smaller government and lower taxes, and that he was passionate about better solutions for people who need help with mental health, homelessness, childcare, veterans and disabilities.
